profile.headline: Senior Software Development Manager
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the government agencies. Skilled in Business Process, SQL, Oracle Database, Requirements Analysis, and Agile Methodologies. Strong engineering professional with a BS focused in Computer Engineering. Self-motivated and versed at setting goals and working to achieve them. Certified SCRUM Master.

positions.title: Senior Software Development Manager
positions.description: Managing the development team working on multiple critical projects  including Foundation School Program and the agency’s content management system.

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description: Lead the development of TEA’s Foundation School Program that distributes funds from the Texas Available School Fund to local school districts. The Foundation School Program distributes funding to more than 1,000 school districts and 200 charter holders, supporting the education of approximately 5.2 million students each year. Texas ranks first among the 50 states in the number of operating school districts and second in the number of students enrolled in public schools.

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description:
Senior Developer in CMBHS project, Clinical Management for Behavioral Health Services (CMBHS) is a web-based clinical record keeping system for state-contracted community mental health and substance abuse service providers, lead the development effort of integrating CMBHS and mainframe systems.
Responsibilities: Build interface using .NET Framework 4.6 and Oracle, to sync transactions between the mainframe CARE (Client Assignment and Registration System) and CMBHS.
Conducted daily scrum meetings.
Prioritizing the back - log which in the case of Customer Success is the tickets assigned to the team which are currently open.

company.name: Texas Department of State Health Services

positions.title: Senior Technical Consultant
positions.description:
Module Lead and Senior Developer in award winning Foundation School Program ASP .NET 3.5 rewrite project, a multibillion dollar state program that distributes funds from the Texas Available School Fund to local school districts, lead the development effort of multiple modules and delivers functionality on time with highly reusable component-based architecture.

Led the design and implementation of FileNet eProcess based workflow solutions working in a 25 member team.
Senior Developer in multiple grant application development in the eGrants project at TEA, an ASP .NET 3.5 web application written in C# that allows organizations to apply for state and federal grant monies.
Piloted the adoption of Scrum to increase engagement, collaboration, and product delivery.
